The chapter likely emphasizes that aging is not uniform—it varies between individuals and even within the same person across different bodily systems.  
Option (A) is true in a general sense but too simplistic; the key point is the variability.  
Option (C) is incorrect because physical changes occur across adulthood, not just in very old age.  
Option (D) is false; aging changes cannot be totally avoided.  
Option (B) captures the nuanced view that aging differs between people and between systems in the same person.  

Final answer: (B)
